tbesh_html:
1) to begin, make a beginning, show willingness, undertake to do, be pleased, be determined
1a) (Hiphil)
1a1) to agree to, show willingness, acquiesce, accept an invitation, be willing
1a2) to undertake
1a3) to resolve, be pleased, be determined

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to yield, especially assent; hence (pos.) to undertake as an act of volition
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (probably rather the same as H2973 (יָאַל) through the idea of mental weakness);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: assay, begin, be content, please, take upon, [idiom] willingly, would.
